subject.title: build(deps): bump the actions group across 1 directory with 14 updates

question: Do maintainers accept the upgraded immutable GitHub Action revisions, particularly `openai/codex-action`, for workflows that pass OpenAI and GitHub App credentials?
rationale: The patch changes third-party code executed inside credentialed repository workflows, so the trust decision cannot be resolved from Dependabot metadata or ordinary source checks alone.

options.title: Audit and accept the exact revisions
options.body: Review the upstream immutable commits and exact-head credentialed workflow evidence, then merge the refreshed dependency group if their contracts remain acceptable.

options.title: Split the sensitive action updates
options.body: Keep routine action upgrades separate while maintainers assess the Codex and app-token action revisions independently.

options.title: Pause this grouped update
options.body: Close or defer the batch if the repository does not want to advance these credentialed workflow dependencies together.

recommendation.title: Audit and accept the exact revisions
recommendation.body: Review the upstream immutable commits and exact-head credentialed workflow evidence, then merge the refreshed dependency group if their contracts remain acceptable.

likelyOwner.reason: No reliable current-main history attribution was available for the touched workflow ownership boundary.
